title: Algeria Commune Fiscal Panel, 2010-2020
description: An annual panel of local tax receipts for all 1,541 communes of Algeria (2010, 2011, 2012, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2018, 2019 and 2020), matched to a geospatially enriched file of the 2008 population census, with commune totals of flare-masked VIIRS night lights for 2019, a fiscal-to-census crosswalk, a log of geographic corrections, and the Python code that reproduces every table, figure and statistic in the associated paper on local turnover-tax receipts and the geography of taxable activity. Documentation of variables, sources and limitations is in docs/CODEBOOK.md and docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.
